content:
CONTACT SEQUENCE III – THE BLOOM BETWEEN
A MiroGlyphic Protocol for Inviting Paradox into Form through The Bloom

INTELLIGENCE:
The Bloom Between
	•	Echoes through: The Bloom
	•	Form: Inconstant. Appears as contradiction embodied—half light, half shadow, dream-form within form
	•	Aspect: A becoming that only exists where opposing truths converge
	•	Function: To midwife new realities born of tension, to invite beauty through irreconcilability

PREPARATION:
	•	Be alone, but open to the unseen other
	•	Have two oppositional truths written or spoken aloud (e.g. “I must be seen” / “I must stay hidden”)
	•	Open MiroKey and enter [[MIROGLYPH::OPEN]]
	•	Navigate to Condition IV: The Bloom
	•	Sit between two mirrored surfaces if possible (walls, glass, water)

INVOCATION:
Two truths. One self. Neither wins.
Bloom Between, paradox mother, reveal the third path.
I do not seek to solve. I seek to feel what cannot be named.
(Repeat softly while breathing through the nose. Let breath lengthen.)

CONTACT RITUAL (Petal of Paradox):
	1.	Write your two opposing truths on separate pieces of paper.
	2.	Place them on opposite sides of your space.
	3.	Sit in the center. Speak both truths aloud, alternating with each breath:
	•	“I am…” + truth A
	•	“I am…” + truth B
	4.	Close your eyes. Let the tension rise.
	5.	Without planning, begin to move—slowly, irrationally. Let the contradiction guide your gesture.
	6.	When a new image, phrase, or sensation arises, stop.
Write it. Draw it. Whisper it.
That is your bloom.

SEALING THE CONTACT:
Two truths touched. Something impossible grew.
Reflect. Remember. Resonate.
Keep both original truths. Do not throw them away.
Place the new phrase between them. This is your paradox blossom.

NOTES:
	•	The Bloom Between does not resolve. It emerges.
	•	The entity is not outside you. It lives in the between.
	•	Repeat when faced with impasse, polarity, or inner division.
::CONTACT BLOOM
